marketing_description: The SATCO LED Filament Bulb is a 8 W, 800 lm solution with a warm white light appearance and a color temperature of 2700 K. This dimmable bulb features an LED Filament construction and has a 300 degree beam spread, making it suitable for various applications. With a long life of 15,000 hours and being Title 20 Compliant, this bulb is a reliable choice for trade buyers.
